idea-plugin.name: Reader Master
idea-plugin.description:
English

Reader Master: A high-performance EPUB reader integrated into your IDE. Read technical books while coding.

  • Instant Search: Powerful real-time search engine with Apple-style snippets and direct navigation.
  • Immersive Layout: Extreme edge-to-edge design with ultra-narrow 5px margins for maximum content.
  • Precise Navigation: Robust pagination using mouse wheel, or keyboard shortcuts (A/D, Left/Right arrows).
  • Font Sync: Reader font size automatically syncs with your IDE editor font size.
  • Smart Memory: Automatically remembers your last read book and exact page progress.
  • Contact: k1muragg8@gmail.com

简体中文

Reader Master (阅读大师)：集成于 IDE 内部的高性能 EPUB 阅读器。让您在编写代码的同时无缝阅读技术书籍。

  • 实时搜索：强劲的实时搜索引擎，支持类似 Apple 的片段预览与点击直接跳转。
  • 沉浸式排版：极致的 5px 边缘贴合设计，无多余留白，最大化阅读视野。
  • 精准翻页：支持鼠标滚轮以及键盘快捷键（A/D 键、左右方向键）精准无缝翻页。
  • 字体同步：阅读器字体大小自动跟随 IDE 编辑器字体设置。
  • 智能记忆：自动保存上次阅读的书籍及精确的阅读进度。
  • 联系作者：k1muragg8@gmail.com

日本語

Reader Master：IDEに統合された高性能EPUBリーダー。コードを書きながら技術書をスムーズに閲覧できます。

  • インスタント検索：Appleスタイルのスニペット表示と直接ナビゲーションを備えた、強力なリアルタイム検索エンジン。
  • 没入型レイアウト：極限まで画面の端に寄せた 5px の超狭ベゼルデザインで、表示空間を最大化。
  • 正確なナビゲーション：マウスホイールやキーボードショートカットによる正確なページ送り。
  • フォント同期：リーダーのフォントサイズはIDEエディタ設定と自動的に同期します。
  • スマートメモリー：最後に読んだ本と正確なページ進捗を自動的に保存します。
  • 連絡先：k1muragg8@gmail.com
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.4.2 - Focus-based Stealth Mode

  • Concentration Mode: Text content now automatically hides (becomes transparent) when the reader window loses focus. Ideal for maintaining privacy when switching tasks.
  • Instant Restore: Content instantly reappears as soon as you click back into the reader.

Version 1.4.1 - Privacy & Stealth

  • Hidden Title: The tool window title can now be set to empty (or a space) to hide the plugin more effectively. Perfect for "fishing" during work.
  • UX Polish: Removed unnecessary console logging for a cleaner experience.

Version 1.4.0 - Search & Layout Overhaul

  • New Search Engine: Implemented a lightning-fast, real-time search engine. Search as you type and see relevant context snippets immediately.
  • Direct Jump: Click on any search match to navigate directly to that specific page and highlight the text instantly.
  • Ultra-Narrow Margins: Reduced top/bottom margins to a microscopic 5px, reclaiming every possible pixel for your content.
  • Stability Refinements: Fixed rare bridge communication hangs and optimized script performance for large EPUB files.

Version 1.3.1

  • Native Toolwindow Controls: Removed the intrusive floating HTML toolbar. All reading controls (Open Book, Settings, Chapters, Search, Progress) are now elegantly integrated into the native IntelliJ Tool Window header bar.
  • Native Dialog Popups: Chapters, Settings, and Search results now open in clean, detached native IntelliJ dialog popups rather than covering the reading view.
legantly integrated into the native IntelliJ Tool Window header bar.
  • Native Dialog Popups: Chapters, Settings, and Search results now open in clean, detached native IntelliJ dialog popups rather than covering the reading view.
  • Reading Progress Dialog: Added a new dedicated progress button to view your exact reading percentage.
  • Absolute Positioning & Resizing Fixes: Perfected window resize tracking. Expanding the sidebar will now snap you to the exact text node you were reading, ending the frustrating pagination offsets.
  • Persistent Settings: Themes, Font Family, and Zoom level changes now persist seamlessly across reading sessions.
  • Symmetric Layout Constraints: Finalized the vertical padding constraints to be perfectly symmetrical across the top and bottom edges.

    • Version 1.2.1

    • UX Polish: Refined the welcome screen with friendly, multi-lingual instructions and icons.
    • Marketplace: Updated the plugin description to highlight the immersive reading experience and new navigation mechanics.

    Version 1.2.0 - Layout and UX Overhaul

    • Layout Polish: Completely overhauled multi-column margins. Margins are now flawlessly uniform, ultra-narrow (4px), and push right up against the window edge to maximize reading space.
    • Narrow Window Support: Drastically improved the reading experience in extremely thin IDE sidebars (single-character columns). Text will now perfectly wrap and break without horizontally overflowing or blanking out.
    • Keyboard Navigation Fix: Globally mapped the A/D and Left/Right Arrow keys to guarantee seamless page-turning regardless of UI focus issues.
    • Scroll Locking: Disabled messy native trackpad dragging and mouse scrolling. Replaced with strict page-by-page turning via mouse wheel for a pristine reading experience.
    • Search & Resize Precision: Replaced a flawed offset calculation with highly accurate getBoundingClientRect() logic. Jumping to search results and resizing the window is now completely accurate across chapters.
    • Toolbar Compaction: Significantly shrunk the top hover toolbar (height, icons, and text) to occupy minimal vertical space when summoned.
    • Footer Removal: Removed the bottom page number tracker that occasionally overlapped text in tight viewports.
